title: Multi-Spectre
description: when a player has been killed by another player, they turn into a ghost
body:
Ever wanted an alternative to hardcore? well look no further! with Spectre, when a player dies, they get turned into a ghost, invisible to other players and invincible!

![SpectreBanner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2c19b33c19ef414dff2c323817a91072abee925b.png)

When a player dies from another player, they get given the invisibility effect, resistance, and regeneration.

side affects: no more pesky death messages!

this mod was made in a mod race with MrBadoongy. check out his mod: random rogue! [Random rougue](https://modrinth.com/mod/random-rogue)
